feature: Policy Decisions -- own-table register (#1724, Feature #1490) -- the real customer-facing Policy Decisions page in artifacts/portal (/policy-decisions), wired to GET/POST /api/portal/policy-register, PATCH /api/portal/policy-register/:id/clearance/resolve, and GET /api/portal/compliance-obligations -- see docs/policy-decisions-contract-pack.md. No fixture module: every row on screen comes from these endpoints. This is a DIFFERENT register from the risk-derived GET /api/portal/policy-decisions view already covered by test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json's A2/UI6 (PolicyDecisionsCard on the Risk Register page) -- the two are never merged, per contract pack §0/§9.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the real live-empty read (policy_decisions holds 0 rows for the testbed tenant, verified by direct SELECT this session -- {decisions: []} is a true empty, not a read failure), the real obligations catalogue read (8 real seeded compliance_obligations rows, verified by direct SELECT), the 400 validation guard on an invalid create body, and the 404 on a clearance-resolve for a decision that does not exist.

WHY NO HAPPY-PATH CREATE IS DRIVEN HERE: a signed policy decision has no delete route -- POST /api/portal/policy-register creates a permanent, signed row (same 'no unsigned intermediate state' design as Risk Register's accept). A step that successfully creates one would leave real fixture-looking rows in the live register on every run of this manifest, which is exactly the invented-data outcome this project forbids. If a real create needs proving end-to-end, do it the same way risk-register.json's A3/A4 notes describe: seed + a manual one-off session, then reset the DB -- never as a repeatable manifest step.

WHY THE UI DOES NOT ASSERT A REAL ROW ON THE REGISTER: the testbed tenant's own-table register is genuinely empty (0 rows) -- there is no real row to assert into the DOM the way risk-register.json's UI2 does. UI2 below instead asserts the real obligations catalogue's first row (8 real seeded rows, stable, not user-writable) reached the DOM -- the same 'endpoint's first real value shows up under its own testid' proof, on the one real dataset this page can show without writing anything.
ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

apiTests.name: SETUP -- log in as the designated testbed portal account; extract the bearer.
A1 -- the own-table register answers 200 with an array (genuinely empty for the testbed tenant, verified live -- not a failure).
A2 -- the obligations catalogue answers 200 with the real 8-row seeded set.
A2b -- take the first real obligation's id, the value UI2 below proves reached the DOM.
A3 -- an invalid create body (missing every required field) is refused 400, not silently accepted or 500.
A4 -- resolving the clearance of a decision id that does not exist 404s, idempotently re-runnable (no state written on a 404).
